name: Old Yellowback
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The ZONE EVENT BOSS for Sulphur Bight: the great toad of the yellow flats, older than Yellowpan. P1 'The Flats': a tongue that drags its target in, a gas belch, and a leap at whoever is farthest. P2 at 55% 'The Spawning': it sits on a ward of yellow slime while its spawn hatch — KILL THE TOADLINGS to drop it — and acid rain leaves poison puddles. P3, a new health bar 'The Last Croak': the Great Croak blasts the whole flat (hide behind a crust chimney), it tries to swallow a player whole (three of you stand with them so it cannot fit you all in), and a belly flop that throws everyone. Soft enrage from 4 minutes, hard at 7.
party: Zone event, everyone nearby joins. Solo: not intended (the swallow needs 3, the spawn come in fours). 3-5: playable. 10+: intended. M5 scaling: health and spawn by players enrolled; stack need = clamp(players/4, 2, 5).

pull: The yellow flat heaves. A back as wide as a barn comes up out of it.
Old Yellowback opens its eyes. They are older than the town.
A croak so deep you feel it in your teeth.
say.death: Old Yellowback settles into the flat, croaks once, softly, and is still.
say.reset: Old Yellowback sinks back under the yellow mud.

enrage.say: Old Yellowback swells up, fat with sulphur and spite!

soft.say: The flats steam harder. The air turns yellow.

tongue.name: Long Tongue
tongue.say: Yellowback's tongue whips out at {target} — it drags you in!

leap.name: Great Leap
leap.say: Old Yellowback crouches and leaps at {target}!

acid_rain.name: Acid Rain
acid_rain.say: Yellow rain falls — and it eats the ground where it lands!

great_croak.name: The Great Croak
great_croak.say: Its throat swells huge — get behind a crust chimney!

swallow.name: Swallow Whole
swallow.say: Old Yellowback wants to swallow {target} — three of you stand with them so it cannot fit you all in!

flop.name: Belly Flop
flop.say: Old Yellowback rears up — get clear of the flop!

phases.name: The Spawning
phases.say: The flat bubbles. Its spawn are hatching!
phases.shieldDown: The last toadling bursts — Old Yellowback heaves itself up, furious!

onEnter.say: Old Yellowback sits on a ward of yellow slime. Kill its four spawn to drop it! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.

ward.say: Old Yellowback sits on a ward of yellow slime. Kill its four spawn to drop it! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

phases.name: The Last Croak
phases.say: My children! The flats will have you for this.

do.say: Every crust chimney is rubble. Nothing left to hide behind!
